# Assignment: Repurpose an Ajaia Report Into Multi-Channel Content

**Time box: 2 hours. Hard stop.**

## Objective

This assignment assesses whether you can do the actual work of this role at Ajaia.

We want to see how you take a high-value source asset, translate it into channel-native content, and produce **production-ready outputs** across writing, design, short-form video, and AI-assisted workflow.

This is deliberately small. We are not testing volume. We are testing:

- judgment under a real constraint
- sharpness of execution
- taste
- AI-native workflow

Everything you submit should be publishable as-is. Three strong assets beat ten average ones.

---

## Scenario

Ajaia has published a thought-leadership report:

**2026 AI Reality Check Report**
https://ajaia.ai/2026-ai-reality-check-report

The report is positioned as a strategic roadmap for scaling AI value across the enterprise, with a focus on helping leaders move from pilots and experimentation to measurable business impact.

Turn this single source asset into a focused content package across X, LinkedIn, and short-form video.

---

## Suggested Time Budget

| Block | Time |
|---|---|
| Read report, pick angles | 15 min |
| Video edit | 40 min |
| LinkedIn post + asset | 25 min |
| X posts + visuals | 20 min |
| KPI plan | 10 min |
| Walkthrough recording | 10 min |

You do not have to follow this. It is here so you know what we think the shape of a good 2 hours looks like.

---

## Tasks

### 1. Video Edit (required, weighted heaviest)

Download and edit this source video:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mJYGFF4ZNp3VmsZcXz6q8M_cS0OTlxRo/view?usp=sharing

Produce **one fully edited short-form video, 30 to 60 seconds.**

Required:

- a hook that lands in the first 1 to 3 seconds
- tight cuts and clean pacing
- captions
- on-screen text with clear visual hierarchy

Optional: overlays, motion, b-roll, graphics. Only if they earn their place.

You have full freedom to cut and restructure. The output should be ready to post to LinkedIn, X, or any short-form platform.

Instead of a separate script deliverable, write **five bullets** explaining the edit: your hook choice, what you cut and why, your on-screen text strategy, the CTA, and one thing you would test in a second version.

---

### 2. LinkedIn Post + Designed Asset

Create **one LinkedIn post** with a companion visual.

The visual is either a single graphic or a carousel of no more than 5 slides.

Voice: sharp, credible, operator-minded, practical, AI-forward. Written for an enterprise buyer who has already sat through a failed pilot.

Production-ready means production-ready. Correct dimensions, real typography, no placeholder text.

---

### 3. X Posts + Visuals

Create **two X posts.**

One standalone post and one short thread, or two standalone posts. Your call, but tell us why in the walkthrough.

At least one must carry a supporting visual. Graphics should feel native to X and reinforce the idea rather than decorate it.

---

### 4. KPI Plan

One page or less, covering X, LinkedIn, and short-form video.

For each channel:

- primary KPI
- why it matters
- what success would suggest
- what underperformance would tell you to change

Be specific. Generic engagement metrics with no decision attached to them will not score.

---

### 5. Walkthrough Video

Record **3 minutes or less** covering:

- your angles and why you picked them
- how you adapted the report across channels
- how you approached the edit
- which AI tools you used, and where they saved you time
- where human judgment mattered most

Unlisted YouTube link. Screen share is fine. Do not over-produce this.

---

## Deliverables

- 1 fully edited short-form video, 30 to 60 sec
- 5 bullets on your edit decisions
- 1 LinkedIn post with designed asset
- 2 X posts, at least one with a visual
- 1 KPI plan
- 1 walkthrough video link

---

## Submission Format (Required)

Submit **one Google Drive folder link** containing:

- a document with your X and LinkedIn posts plus your five edit bullets
- all designed graphics and assets
- your final edited video file
- your KPI document

In the application field, paste your **Google Drive folder link** and your **unlisted YouTube walkthrough link**.

Submissions without a complete Google Drive folder will not be reviewed.

---

## Constraints

Maximum time: **2 hours.**

You may use any AI tools. We are evaluating how effectively you use them to improve speed, quality, design, and workflow.

If you run out of time, submit what you have and say so in the walkthrough. Cutting scope deliberately and telling us why scores better than submitting rushed work. Going over the time box and telling us scores worse than either.

---

## Quality Bar

Optimize for production-readiness, clarity, editorial judgment, design quality, clean video execution, channel fit, and taste.

If something is not strong enough to publish, cut it and say why.

---

## What We Will Evaluate

- video editing quality and pacing
- strength of writing and hooks
- visual design quality
- channel-native thinking
- ability to express Ajaia's voice
- editorial judgment and repurposing skill
- KPI literacy
- clarity of walkthrough
- evidence of AI-native execution
- how you handled the constraint

---

## Optional Stretch

Only if you are under time. Two or three sentences each:

- which asset you would publish first
- how you would sequence the rest over one week
- how you would iterate based on early performance
